success.multiple_comparison_policy: Fixed sequence: independent J-S, then independent J-R1. Each stage requires both interference superiority and natural noninferiority using source-paired 95% percentile intervals. Shared calibration, J-R2, S-R1 and candidate-level analyses are exploratory and make no additional formal significance claims.
success.history: Historically used sources; these are prespecified comparisons within an exploratory reevaluation

protocol.score_shift_from_raw: Includes fitted intercept; uncalibrated corrections are saved by training runner
protocol.pooled_estimator: Source bootstrap recomputes pooled ratios; fold ratios are never averaged
